text.en:
Item G-038.10 under the Province of Nueva Vizcaya, Title G, Appendix A of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred and eleven, is amended to read as follows:
"G-038.10. Bone Communal Irrigation System, Construction and repair of canals—GR-3-3-3."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
